title: Velocity at change
description: Essential: Correctly states the magnitude of velocity at the acceleration change as 2.5 m/s.

title: Acceleration ratio
description: Essential: Correctly states the final ratio a1/a2 as 1/3.

title: Displacement equality
description: Important: Applies the condition that the total displacement is zero, meaning the distances in each phase are equal in magnitude.

title: Kinematic equations
description: Important: Correctly uses velocity-displacement (v^2 = u^2 + 2as) or velocity-time equations for both phases.

title: Sign convention
description: Important: Maintains a consistent sign convention for acceleration and velocity, noting the reversal in the second phase.

title: Simultaneous equation solving
description: Optional: Shows clear algebraic steps to solve for the unknown velocity and the ratio.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Explicitly includes or verifies correct units (m/s) for velocity.

title: Sign error in final velocity
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly uses the final speed of 5 m/s as positive in the second phase's kinematic equation without accounting for direction.

title: Incorrect displacement sum
description: Pitfall: Sets the sum of displacements to zero but incorrectly adds them as both positive scalars.
